title: Loop MMT app-page manifest
description: The per-app data that drives an app page's Files zone (C) and Play modal (D). Hand-authored now (D2, S09.2312), shaped so a later `git ls-tree`->manifest generator can emit it unchanged. One manifest per app; lives inlined in the page during the design/ mockup phase and at apps/<app>/app-manifest.json once deployed.

app.description: The app's slug — matches the repo folder apps/<app>/ and the site route.

repo_base.description: The public repo root. File blob links are repo_base + '/blob/main/apps/<app>/<path>'; the folder button is repo_base + '/tree/main/apps/<app>/'.

files.description: The files behind the app, in the order they should be listed (zone C). Optional/empty for multi-file apps shown repo-forward (see files_note).

path.description: Path relative to apps/<app>/ — the filename shown and the blob link target.

role.description: One short line: what this file is.

play.description: Drives the Play modal (zone D). ready:false renders the honest 'coming with the open-source release' state instead of a live button.

ready.description: true = browser-playable now (Loop 2.1, Beam Wizards, Jamie's Garden); false = not public / not browser-runnable yet.

url.description: The served app URL for the iframe src and the full-tab escape. Required when ready:true.

width.description: Preferred modal width in px; the modal clamps to min(width, 96vw).

height.description: Preferred modal height in px; the modal clamps to min(height, 88vh).

reason.description: Shown on the Play button when ready:false, in place of the default. Lets the not-ready state match the app (public-but-local vs not-public-yet).

files_note.description: One honest line for apps not enumerated file-by-file (e.g. multi-file Node apps shown repo-forward).
examples: A Node app — clone & run locally.
